script: NBA stars who BLEW UP their own team to FORCE their way out! Jimmy Butler was one of the best two-way players in the NBA when Minnesota traded for him in twenty seventeen. He reunited with his old coach Tom Thibodeau and made the All-Star team, then dragged the Timberwolves to the playoffs for the first time since two thousand four. But the two young stars sitting next to him were about to become the reason he wanted out. He thought Karl-Anthony Towns and Andrew Wiggins were too soft and didn't compete hard enough, so that summer he turned down a four-year extension and asked to be traded. Then he stayed away from the team for the entire preseason while Minnesota refused to move him. But when he finally walked into that gym days before the opener, he did something so brutal that everyone knew his time there was basically over. He grabbed the third-string guys who were stuck at the end of the bench and put them up against the starters in a scrimmage. Then he beat Towns and Wiggins with those scrubs while screaming at the general manager, "You need me. You can't win without me." Towns got so frustrated that he kicked the ball away! Teague said they were mesmerized while Butler walked out like he'd dropped a mic, and one month later Minnesota gave up and shipped him to Philadelphia to join Joel Embiid and Ben Simmons.
